notes:
USAGE: {発想|はっそう} emphasizes the creative or conceptual aspect of thinking, often highlighting originality or a fresh perspective.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {発想|はっそう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{豊|ゆた}か→豊か：03654_yutaka⟧ (rich in ideas)
- {発想|はっそう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{転換|てんかん}→転換：19439_tenkan⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to change one's way of thinking)
- {発想|はっそう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{面白|おもしろ}い→面白い：00589_omoshiroi⟧ (interesting idea/approach)
- {発想|はっそう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{転換|てんかん}→転換：19439_tenkan⟧ (paradigm shift)
